C0400.title: Traction Control Solenoid Valve Circuit
C0400.description: The dedicated traction control isolation valve in the hydraulic block reports an electrical fault.

C0401.title: Traction Control Switch Circuit
C0401.description: The TCS on/off switch reports an implausible state.

C0402.title: Traction Control Lamp Circuit
C0402.description: The TCS indicator lamp control circuit is shorted or open.

C0405.title: Traction Control Active Too Long
C0405.description: TCS regulation has been continuously active longer than allowed, suggesting persistent low-friction conditions or a sensor fault.

C0410.title: Adaptive Cruise Control Sensor Circuit Malfunction
C0410.description: The adaptive cruise control module has detected a fault in its forward-looking radar or lidar sensor circuit. ACC and forward collision warning are unavailable while the fault is active.

causes.label: Radar sensor blocked by snow, ice or dirt

C0420.title: Adaptive Cruise Control Module Internal Performance
C0420.description: The adaptive cruise control module has reported an internal performance fault — for example self-test failure, supply voltage out of range or invalid configuration. ACC is disabled.

causes.label: Module configuration invalid after part exchange

C0440.title: Steering Wheel Position Sensor Circuit
C0440.description: The steering angle sensor reports an electrical fault. ESC and lane keeping assistance functions are typically disabled.

C0445.title: Steering Wheel Position Sensor Calibration
C0445.description: The steering angle sensor has not been calibrated after a service operation, or the calibration value is implausible.

C0450.title: Rear Wheel Steering Position Sensor Circuit
C0450.description: On vehicles with active rear wheel steering, the rear position sensor reports an electrical fault. The system disables rear steering.

C0455.title: Steering Wheel Position Sensor Circuit
C0455.description: The chassis or stability control module has detected a fault in the steering wheel position sensor circuit. ESP and lane assist systems require an accurate steering angle and may be deactivated.

C0460.title: Steering Position Signal Implausible
C0460.description: Steering angle signal is implausible compared with yaw rate, lateral acceleration and wheel speeds.

C0496.title: Yaw Rate Sensor Circuit
C0496.description: The yaw rate sensor reports an electrical fault. ESC is disabled while the fault is active.

C0497.title: Yaw Rate Sensor Range/Performance
C0497.description: The yaw rate sensor signal is implausible relative to steering angle and lateral acceleration.

causes.label: Sensor element aged beyond calibration window

C0498.title: Lateral Acceleration Sensor Circuit
C0498.description: The lateral acceleration sensor reports an electrical fault.

C0499.title: Lateral Acceleration Sensor Range/Performance
C0499.description: The lateral acceleration sensor signal is outside the plausibility range.

causes.label: Sensor element aged beyond calibration window
